name: Jirai o daigaku e tsureteiku!
original_name: 地雷を大学へ連れていく！
source:
[A tutoring simulation to guide a troubled girl!]

The protagonist has passed his university entrance exams and will be moving to Tokyo in the spring.
When he tells a male friend he met through online gaming about it, they make plans to meet in person.
His heart is pounding with excitement as he heads to his first offline meeting, only to find that the person waiting for him is a troubled girl!
